ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER K

Letter K — Kite.

An orange kite with ribbon bows flies in for the letter K. K clicks like a tiny lock, and the kite gives the click somewhere wonderful to go.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does K say?

“k — kuh, a clean click”

K says kuh — a clean little click at the back of the mouth, exactly like c in cat. Two letters, one sound: that is a fun secret to tell your child.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace K k together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase K

Start at 1 at the top, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 at the top right, slide down to the middle of the stem. Lift. Start at 3 in the middle, slide down to the bottom right.

Trace the lowercase k

Start at 1 at the top, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 at the top right, slide in to the stem. Lift. Start at 3 in the middle, slide out to the bottom right.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Kite run.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Run around the garden or room holding a ribbon or scarf behind you like a kite tail.

  2. 02

    Say kuh, kuh, kite with every lap.

  3. 03

    Crash-land on a cushion at the end, laughing.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
